description: This Java source file defines the class 'GenericEntity', which is a core class within the Apache OFBiz framework. It represents a generic data entity with dynamic fields and provides methods for data manipulation, serialization (to XML), comparison, and other utility operations. It acts as a flexible container for entity data, supporting features like change notification, locking, and resource-based localization.

classes.name: GenericEntity
classes.description: A dynamic, flexible implementation of an entity value object in Apache OFBiz. It supports dynamic fields, change notifications, XML serialization, comparison, and localization. It handles persistence and interactions for any defined entity within the framework, including primary key manipulations, resource-based localization, and XML export.
